orders.text:
WPSS No. 1128 of 2020 
Hon’ble Lok Pal Singh, J.
Mr. Subhash Upadhyaya, Advocate for 
the petitioner. 
Mr. Puran Singh Bisht, Addl. C.S.C. with 
Mr. Virendra Singh Rawat, Brief Holder for the 
State. 
Heard. 
As prayed, four weeks’ time is granted to 
learned Government pleader to file counter 
affidavit. 
List thereafter. 
Having heard learned counsel for the 
parties and after going through the material 
available on record, as an interim measure, it 
is directed that promotion, if any, made in the 
Department, the same shall be subject to the 
final decision of the writ petition. 
Interim relief application (CLMA 7915 of 
2020) stands disposed of accordingly 
 (Lok Pal Singh, J.) 
mamta 01.10.2020

Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Rahul Consul, Advocate, for the 
petitioners.
Mrs. Indu Sharma, Brief Holder, for 
the State.
Learned counsel for the petitioners 
submits that the challenge given to the 
impugned seniority list dated 21.09.2020, as 
appended to the writ petition is shown to be a 
tentative seniority list, though apparently on the 
same day i.e. on 21.09.2020, in fact, a final 
seniority list has been issued, which the 
petitioners’ counsel intended to challenge. But 
due to mistake, tentative seniority list has been 
appended with the present writ petition.
The petitioner may do the needful as 
permissible to him under law.
(Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
 25.11.2021 Mahinder/

Consul, Advocates, for the petitioners.
Mrs. Indu Sharma, Brief Holder, for the 
State.
IA/13134/2021, fled by the petitioners,
along with rejoinder affidavit, as well as
IA/13135/2021, along with the supplementary 
affidavit, would stand allowed; rejoinder affidavit 
and the supplementary affidavits are taken on 
record.
To the supplementary affidavit, if so 
advised, learned Brief Holder, may file her 
supplementary counter affidavit, within a period of 
two weeks from today.
As far as the Amendment Application No. 
IA/13136/2021 is concerned, the petitioner has 
sought an amendment in the relief clause by putting 
a challenge to the final seniority list dated 
21.09.2020. 
Since, the amendment is formal in nature, 
the same would stand allowed. The petitioner is 
permitted to carry out the necessary amendment in 
the relief clause, by supplying the amended memo 
of the writ petition, within a period of one week 
from today.
List this writ petition after the expiry of 
two weeks.
(Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
 17.12.2021 Mahinder/
